Senses.Explanation: Zhang Wujin is the lay official Zhang Shangying, named in Chan records as a visitor, questioner, and cited interlocutor. Narrators record his meeting with the monk Hao and his visit to a master at Dayang; Dahui Zonggao, Langting Jingting, Yulin Tongxiu, and Juefan Huihong later discuss statements attributed to him. The name identifies the case figure; it does not make Zhang the utterer of every occurrence.
